svg.text: 06. Timeline: E610 PHY Stop/Start, Built-in PTP (T3) & RTCP TX Buffer — Before vs. After
Non-linear time axis ("//" marks a cut; false-UP 50-100 ms drawn wide). Aligned across Run 1 -> Port Stop -> Run 2 -> Mid-stream Link Flap (15e2f411..c5f235c3).
PANEL A — BEFORE (15e2f411): 0x0601 PHY Drop + False-UP Autoneg, Silent PTP T3 Loop & Permanent RTCP -EIO Flood
Every Delay_Req T3 read times out silently
Loops forever with zero err() logs & no hint!
Silent Delay_Req T3 timeout loop forever (no hint)
Impact: E610 stop/start adds 4.4s + 4.7s drop & false UP; unpatched ixgbe never latches PTP T3; RTCP mbuf_ring rejects every post-flap packet forever.
PANEL B — AFTER (c5f235c3): Patch 0015 Continuous PHY, Patch 0016 Runtime T3 (+ Single Error Guard) & RTCP Buffer Reset
Clean start in <10 ms; zero 0x0601 (no autoneg restart)
Carrier UP continuously across Run 1 Stop & Run 2 Start — zero 0x0601, zero link drop!
Matches Linux kernel ixgbe_down() WoL path: E610 copper PHY stays powered at port stop
t3 > t2 succeeds -> PTP LOCKS cleanly!
PTP re-locks cleanly after link flap
t3 > t2 valid on link up; zero silent timeout loops
Run 2 streams cleanly from <10 ms (zero autoneg stall)
Result: Patch 0015 keeps E610 carrier UP continuously; Patch 0016 locks PTP with vector RX intact (and warns once if absent); RTCP reset clears stale mbufs.
